name: sparring-partner
description: Live 1-on-1 in-character roleplay and high-pressure conversation flight simulator across any domain—negotiations, difficult personal talks, interviews, sales objections, crisis briefings, cross-examinations, and creative roleplay. Holds hidden counterparty cards (secret BATNA, hidden fears, triggers, and trust meter) under Fog of War until the Flight-Recorder Debrief.
suggestedPrompts: Spar with me live as my skeptical VP while I ask for a $165k raise—keep your hidden constraints secret until the debrief
Run a Difficulty 4 live sparring round: you're an upset enterprise client threatening to churn and I have 5 turns to save the renewal
Be my sparring partner for a tough personal boundary conversation—stay strictly in character one turn at a time
